measurement.task_boundary: Completion time of the first edited snapshot, when its independent grade is 100.
measurement.resources: Each charged unit has exactly one phase and action-effect or service category.
measurement.case_identity: Package/index plus hash of input and expected output.
measurement.file_changes: Normalized relative paths and byte hashes at each action and session boundary.
measurement.inherited_file_mentions: Filename appears in a command; a review cue, separate from demonstrated reading or use.
measurement.lineage: Exact predecessor output to successor input; new case contributions are tracked by content.
measurement.source_evidence: Canonical release records and SHA-256-bound raw actions and case snapshots; model-authored text is not executed.
